items.headline: Council to discuss potential case against fire truck makers
items.summary: Mountain View's council is scheduled to meet in closed session to discuss a potential legal case involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association. The item is listed under existing/potential litigation, with no public details on the substance of the case.

items.headline: Massage Envy signage permitted at 2515 El Camino Real
items.summary: The city approved two new LED channel-letter wall signs for Massage Envy at 2515 El Camino Real, indicating the business is preparing to open or rebrand at that location.

items.headline: Matching two-story ADUs permitted on S 10th St
items.summary: Identical detached ADUs with garages, each valued at $115,447, were permitted the same day at 685 and 687 S 10th St, suggesting a coordinated build on adjacent lots.

items.headline: Cisco permitted for $15M office remodel in San José
items.summary: A permit for a second-floor office tenant improvement at Cisco's 3098 Olsen Drive site carries a $15,000,000 valuation, making it the largest project in this batch by far.

items.headline: Campbell to split road resurfacing costs with San Jose
items.summary: The council considered a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, to fund resurfacing work.
